description.value: You creatively apply your prepared spells to Counterspell a much wider variety of your opponents’ magic. Instead of being able to counter a foe’s spell with Counterspell only if you have a qualifying spell prepared, you can use Counterspell if you have the spell the foe is casting in your spellbook. When you use Counterspell in this way, you can either expend a qualifying spell without suffering a penalty, or use a prepared spell that has an opposing trait or that would otherwise logically counter the triggering spell (such as using a cold or water spell to counter @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind} to counter a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear} spell).
